name: Marching Cubes Chunk Generation Pipeline
aliases: Procedural Terrain Generation with Marching Cubes
definition: A procedural terrain generation pipeline that divides a 3D volume into overlapping chunks, populates them with noise-derived node values, and prepares chunk meshes for Marching Cubes surface extraction.
summary: The Marching Cubes Chunk Generation Pipeline is a procedural terrain method that divides 3D volumes into overlapping chunks to ensure seamless boundary continuity during surface extraction.
